protocol_name: Single-cell processing inside semi-permeable capsules: Lysis, wash and reverse transcription chip

events.narration: IR step 16 (lysis_rt_trap): load the capsules from the hand-off from chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter: syringe on inlet_1 at 20 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out. Every other port capped.

IR step 16 (lysis_rt_trap): exchange to lysis_buffer: FEED inlet_1 (lysis_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Exchange the buffer for lysis buffer and incubate the capsules.
IR step 16 (lysis_rt_trap): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 22 C for 10 min (placeholder time). Exchange the buffer for lysis buffer and incubate the capsules.

IR step 17 (lysis_rt_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED inlet_1 (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 3 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules in wash buffer.

IR step 18 (lysis_rt_trap): exchange to rt_mix: FEED inlet_1 (rt_mix) at 20 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Exchange the buffer for reverse transcription mix and incubate the capsules.
IR step 18 (lysis_rt_trap): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 42 C for 1 h (placeholder time). Exchange the buffer for reverse transcription mix and incubate the capsules.

IR step 19 (lysis_rt_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED inlet_1 (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 2 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules twice.
IR step 19 (lysis_rt_trap): collect the capsules: FEED reagent_line_in (buffer push), VENT outlet_1 into a tube labelled 'chip3_lysis_wash_rt: capsules after step 19'. Every other port capped.
